outputCopy.heroIntroduction: For local residents seeking clinical advice for common health conditions, Yorkshire Pharmacy & Health Clinic provides the NHS Pharmacy First service for eligible people from Goldthorpe. Through this service, a qualified pharmacist evaluates symptoms and offers professional advice or treatment.
outputCopy.localIntroduction:
Goldthorpe is a settlement in the Dearne Valley, situated within the Metropolitan Borough of Barnsley in South Yorkshire. Historically associated with the local coal mining industry, the village expanded during the early twentieth century following the opening of the local colliery. Today, it forms part of the wider Dearne constituency.

The area is served by various community facilities, including the Dearne Playhouse, which hosts local performances, alongside local shops and educational settings. Primary healthcare provision within the village includes Goldthorpe Medical Centre. Residents also have access to nearby green spaces such as Phoenix Park, a reclaimed former colliery site that provides outdoor pathways and open grounds for the surrounding population.

To support everyday health requirements across the community, Yorkshire Pharmacy & Health Clinic provides Pharmacy First consultations for eligible people from the area. The Pharmacy First service covers certain common health conditions, during which the pharmacist assesses symptoms, relevant medicines and medical history. Following this evaluation, the outcome may include clinical advice, suitable treatment or referral to another healthcare professional. Eligibility and treatment depend entirely on the individual clinical assessment.
outputCopy.relationshipToPharmacy: Consultations take place at Yorkshire Pharmacy & Health Clinic in Darfield. Yorkshire Pharmacy & Health Clinic is approximately 4.8 km in a straight line from Goldthorpe.
